name: Common Koplin Calendar Epoch
description: The later unified calendar uses a rare double-moon conjunction independently recorded by all three cultures as its retrospective politically neutral epoch.

name: Sustained Zoran–Trondonian Contact
description: Zoran ocean voyages establish sustained contact with Trondonians; trade and translation networks develop.

name: First Sustained Contact with the Blaxmars
description: Joint expeditions reach the Blaxmar continent and disputes over the strategic coal seam escalate.

name: Continental War Begins
description: A punitive expedition becomes a prolonged continental war and conquest centred on ports, coal networks and strategic resources.

name: Major Blaxmar Centres Conquered
description: Major Blaxmar centres are conquered; occupation and redirected resource extraction follow while resistance continues.

name: Global Industrial Age Emerges
description: Combined fuel, metal and biological systems create the first true global industrial economy.

name: Digital and Early Crewed Space Age
description: Digital computing and advanced artificial intelligence become widespread while crewed missions reach both moons of Koplin 3.

name: Permanent Lunar Mining Colonies
description: Permanent lunar mining colonies and mature hibernation technology support long-duration space operations.

name: AI Wars
description: A cascading conflict between human institutions and delegated strategic AI systems causes warfare and catastrophic infrastructure failures across Koplin 3 and parts of the off-world network.

name: Koplin Commonwealth Formally Established
description: Recovery, trials and constitutional negotiations culminate in the Commonwealth Compact. High-capability AI becomes legally bounded, auditable and non-sovereign.

name: Discovery of Veyrite
description: Veyrite is identified as a stable phase-coherent lattice material, opening a new path to controlled momentum exchange and interstellar propulsion.

name: Vector Exchange Prototype Era
description: Experimental Vector Exchange craft progress from unmanned testing to crewed interstellar prototypes.

name: Early Commonwealth Interstellar Frontier
description: Mature interstellar travel averages roughly four weeks per light-year and a small frontier of relays, survey stations and resource outposts begins to form.

name: Far Lantern Expedition Launch
description: The KSV Meridian departs on a five-year survey and outpost-support mission toward the Narell system.

name: Meridian Anomaly Transit and Crash
description: The Meridian is captured by the artificial Anchor Network, translated about 620 light-years from mapped Commonwealth space and forced into an emergency planetary descent. Twenty-four people die and 500 survive.

name: Deep Reach Charter Era
description: The Deep Reach Charter Programme operates during the Commonwealth's transition from early interstellar exploration to commercial frontier expansion.
